argv:
cd /app/cs61_fa24_hw08 && cat > hw08.scm <<'EOF'
(define (ascending? s)
  (if (or (null? s) (null? (cdr s)))
      #t
      (and (<= (car s) (car (cdr s)))
           (ascending? (cdr s)))))

(define (my-filter pred s)
  (cond ((null? s) nil)
        ((pred (car s)) (cons (car s) (my-filter pred (cdr s))))
        (else (my-filter pred (cdr s)))))

(define (interleave lst1 lst2)
  (cond ((null? lst1) lst2)
        ((null? lst2) lst1)
        (else (cons (car lst1)
                    (cons (car lst2)
                          (interleave (cdr lst1) (cdr lst2)))))))

(define (no-repeats s)
  (if (null? s)
      nil
      (cons (car s)
            (no-repeats (my-filter (lambda (x) (not (= x (car s)))) (cdr s))))))
EOF
echo '=== written ===' && cat hw08.scm
